reason: Both correctly reassure that the gurgling, clicks and cracks are normal refrigerant/liner noises with no part or engineer needed, and neither makes unsupported claims. Conversation 1 is more thorough: it asks the sensible verification questions (level, clearance, cooling fine, click occasional vs repeated), gives the homeowner a clear picture of what would actually indicate a fault, and points to the Bosch/retailer warranty route only if symptoms change. Conversation 2 is accurate but does not check cooling, level or clearance at all, so its reassurance is less well-founded and gives the homeowner less to act on.
